title: Green Beans Tagine
description: A classic Japanese-inspired side dish, blending the flavors of the East with the heartiness of traditional tagine.

ingredients.name: mildly roasted tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most Asian grocery stores

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the trimmed green beans and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until they start to brown.
Add the mildly roasted tagine spice blend and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 8-10 minutes, or until the green beans are tender.
Stir in 1 tablespoon of sesame oil and season with salt to taste.
Transfer the tagine to a serving dish and garnish with chewy sesame seeds.
Serve hot over steamed rice or noodles.
